newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven die in latest Colombia violence.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in latest Colombia violence.

text.p: At least seven people, including twin boys, died in a wave of rebel attacks across Colombia early on Tuesday, officials and media reports said.
The biggest clash took place when an estimated 300 guerrillas of the Cuban-inspired National Liberation Army (ELN) attacked a 17-man police post in the town of Simiti, in northern Bolivar province.
During the battle, which began on Monday night and lasted for 12 hours, three policemen were killed and two wounded, regional police chief Gen. Tobias Duran said.

In the northwestern province of Antioquia, 11-year-old twins Mario and Andres Lopez died when ELN rebels attacked a farm with dynamite near the town of La Union, local media quoted military sources as saying.
In a third incident, two suspected insurgents of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebel group were killed near the Pacific resort of Bahia Solano, army sources said.
